description: This PHP source file defines the class DetailedLeaveRequestMenuConfigurator, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It configures menu screens in the OrangeHRM leave plugin, adjusting the screen based on request parameters to display either a general leave list or a personal leave list.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequestMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring the leave request menu in the OrangeHRM system, changing the displayed screen based on user request parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu screen based on the current HTTP request, switching between 'viewLeaveList' and 'viewMyLeaveList' as needed.
